'''Nogometno društvo Bilje''', commonly referred to as '''ND Bilje''' or simply '''Bilje''', is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club from [[Bilje, Miren-Kostanjevica|Bilje]]. As of the 2024–25 season, they compete in the [[Slovenian Second League]], the second-highest football league in Slovenia. The club was founded in 1946.<ref name = "Klubi"/>"}}
